goal: Reject fee bumping when the change index points to an output without a destination
Avoid silently dropping outputs like OP_RETURN and sending change to a new address
Make fee bumper results easier to extend with metadata
agreement: Concept support to prevent silently dropping OP_RETURN outputs when bumping fees (rustaceanrob)
Suggested using a clearer error message for outputs that cannot receive change (rustaceanrob)
